drafted_from: tool:end-shares-whose-condition-failed's own row (its words, input schema and sample run) and what its sample run answered here; read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "End the shares I let people run my tools by, once the end I gave each has passed, so none stays open past its time", with {"now":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}. It runs tool:end-shares-whose-condition-failed and answers {"ended":[],"waiting":0,"said":...} when no share of yours holds an end.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it reads and removes only its own grant-end rows, which tool:share-anything keeps for each run share given an end.
instructions: 1. Share a run with an end: say "Share it until 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z" to tool:share-anything; it keeps a grant-end row for that share and gives the engine no end.
2. Switch on this tool's wake (wake:switch, every-five-minutes), or run tool:end-shares-whose-condition-failed by hand with {} or {"now": an ISO time}.

3. Read what comes back: ended names each share withdrawn at your door (its grant-end row is removed), waiting counts rows whose time has not passed or names no readable time, and said states it in words.
